settings.title: AI Channel Settings (OpenAI-Compatible)
settings.intro: The same Base URL + API Key can be reused for chat, embedding, and rerank, making billing retrieval and trend analysis integration consistent.

language.label: Language / 语言
language.hint: Takes effect immediately and is saved locally.

accent.label: Global UI Accent
accent.hint: Applies immediately and affects buttons, highlights, and icon emphasis across the app.

model.embeddingHint: Used for bill vector retrieval and semantic recall.
model.rerankHint: Used to rerank retrieval results for better precision.

embeddingToggle.label: Enable Embedding Model
embeddingToggle.hint: When disabled, embedding-related flows are skipped (and logged in debug logs).

rerankToggle.label: Enable Rerank Model
rerankToggle.hint: When disabled, rerank-related flows are skipped (and logged in debug logs).

embeddingSummaryToggle.label: Show semantic recall summary
embeddingSummaryToggle.hint: Display recall hit count, top similarity, and average similarity in assistant analysis results.

embeddingDebugToggle.label: Show semantic recall debug details
embeddingDebugToggle.hint: When enabled, shows recall latency, index size, and hit text for debugging.

bulkConcurrency.label: Bulk AI Recategorization Concurrency
bulkConcurrency.hint: Adjust with slider (5~30). Higher concurrency is faster but more likely to hit model rate limits.

privacy.title: Data Security & Privacy
privacy.l1: Local storage: core data like transactions, accounts, and categories are stored in your browser by default and not auto-uploaded.
privacy.l2: Encrypted transport: use HTTPS for AI requests whenever possible; API key is only used for your configured provider.
privacy.l3: Minimal context: only necessary context is sent when you trigger AI features, avoiding redundant data exposure.
privacy.l4: Privacy protection: review and remove sensitive notes before export/sharing.

embeddingChannel.title: Embedding channel (advanced)
embeddingChannel.desc: Optional: configure a dedicated service for embedding / semantic recall.
embeddingChannel.enabledHint: When enabled, if any of baseUrl/apiKey/model is provided, the embedding channel config will take precedence.
embeddingChannel.modelHint: Leave empty to fall back to the global Embedding model below.
embeddingChannel.baseUrlHint: Leave empty to fall back to the main Base URL above.
embeddingChannel.apiKeyHint: Leave empty to fall back to the main API key above.
embeddingChannel.fallbackHint: Note: if embedding channel is disabled or all override fields are empty, the global defaults are used.

why.title: Why We Built This
why.p1: LedgerFlow keeps bookkeeping light: capture quickly, see trends clearly, and keep actionable suggestions close.
why.p2: Input stays simple, analysis stays clear, and advice stays actionable.

principles.title: Product Principles
principles.l1: Every transaction should be captured quickly.
principles.l2: Every review should reveal trend and cause.

value.title: What You Get
value.l1: Create draft bills from text or screenshots.
value.l2: Ask and review around historical transactions.
value.l3: Move from details to trends in one flow.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security Strategy
privacy.l1: Ledger data stays in browser storage by default.
privacy.l2: Use HTTPS when connecting AI services.
privacy.l3: Only send needed context when you invoke AI.

tips.1: You can paste bill screenshots in the assistant, and AI will extract bookkeeping data automatically
tips.2: Drag images into the assistant for faster expense recognition
tips.3: You can configure AI provider and API Key in Settings
tips.4: All data is stored locally in your browser, and your privacy stays under your control
tips.5: CSV export is supported for spreadsheet analysis
tips.6: Try dark mode from the theme switcher at the bottom of the sidebar

ideas.1: 📌 Do a fixed 10-minute weekly review: what are the top 3 financial events this week?
ideas.2: 📈 Build a rate-watch list: LPR, 10Y treasury, and DXY to form your own macro intuition.
ideas.3: 💡 Tag large expenses (education/health/travel) while bookkeeping for easier month-end optimization.
ideas.4: 🧠 Avoid emotional trading: write your reason first, then decide whether to execute.
ideas.5: 🛟 Keep 3–6 months of emergency cash before taking investment risk.
